exposure: ipilimumab (CTLA-4 inhibitor) and nivolumab combination therapy
outcome: avoidance of orbital exenteration or additional extensive surgery
cohort: The study included 16 patients with a median age of 66 years, diagnosed with locally advanced, multiply recurrent, or metastatic conjunctival melanoma.
finding: The overall objective response rate to ICI therapy was 63% (10 of 16), with 88% (14 of 16) of patients avoiding orbital exenteration or additional extensive surgery.
